column5:
In many cars, the AC can only be turned ON/OFF manually. During long drives, cabin temperature keeps changing due to weather, sunlight, traffic, or night conditions. The driver must repeatedly monitor comfort and press the AC button to maintain a comfortable temperature.
This causes distraction while driving and often results in the cabin becoming either too cold or too warm before the driver reacts.
A simple low-cost solution is needed that can monitor cabin temperature and automatically toggle the AC ON/OFF around user-defined temperature limits (for example, turn AC ON above 27°C and OFF below 22°C) without requiring modification of the vehicle's existing electronics.
